name: Chicken Cacciatore Stuffed Spaghetti Squash
steps: Roast halved squash at 400°F 40 minutes; scrape strands.
Brown chicken with pepper, mushrooms, onion, garlic and oregano; add marinara.
Toss with squash strands, return to shells, top with mozzarella; broil 3 minutes.

name: Chicken Larb Bowls with Cauliflower Rice
steps: Brown chicken in oil; toss off heat with shallot, lime, fish sauce, herbs and pepper flakes.
Sauté cauliflower rice 4 minutes.
Serve larb over cauliflower rice with cucumber.

name: Chicken Kiev-Style Baked Breasts
steps: Mix butter with garlic, parsley, dill; chill. Cut pockets in chicken and stuff with herb butter.
Dip in egg, coat with almond flour; bake at 400°F 25 minutes.
Serve with green beans and lemon.

name: Turkey Kofta with Tahini Sauce
steps: Mix turkey, grated onion, parsley, garlic, spices, egg and salt; form logs on skewers.
Grill or broil 12 minutes, turning.
Whisk tahini, lemon, yogurt and water; serve with cucumber and tomato.

name: Chicken Zucchini Enchilada Skillet
steps: Sauté chicken pieces with onion and cumin in oil.
Add zucchini, beans and sauce; simmer 8 minutes.
Top with cheddar; cover to melt; serve with cilantro and yogurt.

name: Chicken Cauliflower Mac & Cheese Bake
steps: Steam cauliflower; cook pasta al dente; sear diced chicken in oil.
Warm milk, cream cheese, cheddar, Dijon, garlic powder into a sauce.
Combine everything in a dish; bake at 375°F 15 minutes.

name: Duck Breast with Cherry-Balsamic & Greens
steps: Score and season duck; sear skin-side down 8 minutes, flip 4 minutes; rest and slice, discarding excess skin.
Sauté shallot in drippings; add cherries, balsamic, broth, thyme; reduce.
Serve duck over arugula with sauce.

name: Chicken Broccoli Cheddar Stuffed Sweet Potato
steps: Boil whole sweet potatoes 20–25 minutes until tender (boiling keeps the GI far lower than baking); steam broccoli.
Mix chicken, broccoli, half the cheddar, yogurt and garlic powder.
Split potatoes, fill, top with remaining cheddar; broil 3 minutes; add green onion.

name: Chicken Vesuvio (Lightened)
steps: Brown chicken and halved potatoes in oil; add garlic and oregano.
Add wine and broth; roast at 400°F 25 minutes.
Add peas for the last 5 minutes; finish with lemon and parsley.

name: Nashville-Style Hot Chicken (Baked)
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt and half the hot sauce 15 minutes; coat in almond flour with cayenne, paprika, garlic powder.
Bake at 425°F 22 minutes; brush with remaining hot sauce mixed with oil.
Serve with vinegar slaw and pickles.

name: Chicken & Mushroom Stroganoff (Yogurt)
steps: Sear chicken strips in oil; remove. Sauté mushrooms, onion, garlic 8 minutes.
Add broth, paprika, Dijon; reduce; stir in yogurt off heat; return chicken.
Serve over sautéed zoodles with parsley.

name: Chicken Poblano Casserole
steps: Char poblanos; peel and chop. Sear diced chicken with onion and cumin in oil.
Mix chicken, poblano, cauliflower rice, beans, salsa verde, yogurt and half the cheese in a dish.
Top with remaining cheese; bake at 375°F 25 minutes; garnish cilantro.

name: Chicken Thighs with Roasted Fennel & Olives
steps: Toss fennel wedges, olives, garlic with oil; nestle chicken on top with lemon slices and rosemary.
Roast at 425°F 30–35 minutes.
Spoon pan juices over.

name: Chicken & Roasted Cauliflower Pesto Skillet
steps: Roast cauliflower florets with oil at 425°F 20 minutes.
Sear chicken pieces; add tomatoes and spinach.
Toss chicken, cauliflower and pesto; top with parmesan.

name: Chicken & Veggie Kabobs with Chimichurri
steps: Thread chicken and vegetables onto skewers; brush with a third of the oil; season.
Grill 10–12 minutes, turning.
Blend remaining oil, herbs, garlic, vinegar, oregano, pepper flakes; spoon over.

name: Turkey Meatball Zucchini Skillet with Feta
steps: Mix turkey, egg, almond flour, oregano, garlic, salt; form meatballs; brown in oil.
Add zucchini and tomatoes; cover and cook 10 minutes.
Top with feta and lemon.

name: Chicken Chow Mein (Shirataki)
steps: Rinse and dry-fry shirataki 3 minutes; set aside.
Stir-fry chicken in oil; add garlic, ginger, cabbage, carrot, celery 4 minutes.
Add noodles, sprouts, tamari, sesame oil; toss; top green onion.

name: Chicken Spinach Artichoke Casserole
steps: Cook and dice chicken; wilt spinach with garlic.
Mix cream cheese, yogurt, parmesan; fold in chicken, spinach, artichokes.
Top with mozzarella; bake at 375°F 20 minutes.

name: Whole Roasted Turkey Breast with Herb Rub
steps: Rub turkey with oil, garlic, herbs, lemon zest and salt.
Roast at 350°F with broth in the pan 80–90 minutes to 165°F, basting.
Rest 15 minutes; slice; serve with green beans.

name: Chicken Pesto Stuffed Zucchini
steps: Halve zucchini and scoop centers.
Mix chicken, pesto, ricotta and chopped tomato; fill boats.
Top with cheeses; bake at 400°F 25 minutes.

name: Coq au Vin (Lightened)
steps: Brown chicken and bacon in oil; remove. Sauté onion, carrot, mushrooms, garlic; add tomato paste.
Add wine, broth, thyme, bay; return chicken; simmer covered 45 minutes.
Uncover last 10 minutes to reduce; serve with cauliflower mash.

name: Sesame Chicken (No-Sugar Glaze)
steps: Sear chicken pieces in avocado oil until golden.
Add tamari, vinegar, garlic, ginger, sweetener and arrowroot slurry; simmer until glossy; add sesame oil.
Top with sesame seeds and green onion; serve with steamed broccoli.

name: Crustless Chicken Pot Pie Skillet
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, celery, mushrooms in oil; add diced chicken and thyme.
Blend steamed cauliflower with milk; add to skillet with broth; simmer 12 minutes.
Add peas; top with almond flour-parmesan crumble and broil 3 minutes.

name: Chicken Bruschetta Bake
steps: Season chicken, sear 3 minutes per side, transfer to a dish.
Top with diced tomato, basil, garlic, balsamic and mozzarella.
Bake at 400°F 15 minutes; serve on zoodles.

name: Chili Lime Chicken Wings (Baked)
steps: Toss wings with oil, lime zest, garlic, chili powder, cumin, salt.
Bake on a rack at 425°F 40–45 minutes until crisp.
Squeeze lime, add cilantro; serve with celery and yogurt dip.

name: Chicken Kale Caesar Wrap
steps: Whisk yogurt, lemon, Dijon, mashed anchovy.
Toss chopped kale, chicken and parmesan with dressing.
Roll in tortillas.

name: Turkey Chili Stuffed Peppers
steps: Halve peppers; roast 10 minutes.
Brown turkey with onion and spices; add beans and tomatoes; simmer 8 minutes.
Fill peppers, top with cheddar; bake at 400°F 18 minutes; add green onion.

name: Lemon Dill Chicken Salad Cucumber Boats
steps: Mix chicken, yogurt, dill, lemon, celery, onion, salt.
Halve cucumbers lengthwise and scoop seeds.
Fill with chicken salad.

name: Chicken Mole (Simplified)
steps: Sauté onion and garlic; blend with chipotle, tomatoes, cocoa, almond butter, spices, broth.
Brown chicken in oil; pour sauce over; simmer covered 30 minutes.
Top with sesame seeds; serve with cauliflower rice.

name: Chicken Alfredo Spaghetti Squash Boats
steps: Roast halved squash 40 minutes.
Simmer cauliflower and garlic in milk; blend with parmesan and cream cheese.
Toss squash strands with sauce, cooked chicken and spinach; top with mozzarella; broil 3 minutes.

name: Chicken Tortilla-Crusted Casserole (Low-Carb)
steps: Cook and shred chicken; sauté onion.
Layer torn tortillas, chicken, beans, corn, chiles, sauce and cheese in a dish.
Bake at 375°F 25 minutes; serve with yogurt.

name: Za'atar Chicken with Cucumber Yogurt
steps: Rub chicken with za'atar, lemon, oil, garlic, salt; roast with cauliflower at 425°F 25 minutes.
Mix yogurt with cucumber and mint.
Serve chicken with yogurt sauce.

name: Chicken Marbella (No Prunes)
steps: Marinate chicken with olives, capers, garlic, oregano, vinegar, oil, bay 20 minutes.
Roast at 400°F with wine poured around 35 minutes.
Top with parsley; serve with green beans.

name: Turkey Meatballs with Zucchini & Tzatziki Pita
steps: Mix turkey with grated squeezed zucchini, garlic, oregano, egg, almond flour, salt; form meatballs; bake at 400°F 18 minutes.
Mix yogurt, grated cucumber, dill.
Serve in pita halves with tomato and tzatziki.

name: Classic Beef Chili (Bean-Heavy)
steps: Brown beef with onion and pepper in oil; drain fat; add garlic and spices.
Add tomatoes, beans, broth; simmer 45 minutes.
Serve with yogurt, cheddar and jalapeño.

name: Steak with Chimichurri & Roasted Broccoli
steps: Roast broccoli with a third of the oil at 425°F 18 minutes.
Season steak; grill 4–5 minutes per side; rest 5 minutes and slice against the grain.
Blend remaining oil, herbs, garlic, vinegar, oregano, pepper flakes; spoon over steak.

name: Beef & Broccoli Stir-Fry
steps: Toss sliced beef with arrowroot and half the tamari; sear in avocado oil; remove.
Stir-fry broccoli, garlic, ginger 4 minutes; add broth, remaining tamari, vinegar; cover 2 minutes.
Return beef with sesame oil; serve over cauliflower rice with green onion.

name: Pork Tenderloin with Apple & Sage
steps: Season pork; sear in oil; roast at 425°F 15 minutes; rest.
Sauté onion and apple slices with sage; add Dijon, vinegar, broth; reduce.
Slice pork; serve with apple-sage pan sauce and roasted sprouts.

name: Beef Lettuce Wrap Tacos
steps: Brown beef with taco seasoning; drain.
Spoon into lettuce leaves.
Top with pico, avocado, cheddar, yogurt, jalapeño and lime.

name: Pork Chops with Sautéed Cabbage & Mustard
steps: Season chops; sear in oil 4 minutes per side; rest.
Sauté onion and cabbage in the pan 8 minutes; add vinegar, broth and Dijon.
Serve chops over the cabbage.

name: Beef & Vegetable Kabobs
steps: Marinate beef cubes in oil, lemon, garlic, oregano, cumin 20 minutes.
Thread with vegetables; grill 10–12 minutes.
Serve with yogurt-mint sauce.

name: Meatloaf with Hidden Vegetables
steps: Pulse mushrooms, carrot, onion finely; sauté 5 minutes; cool.
Mix with beef, eggs, oats, garlic, Dijon, thyme, salt; shape a loaf.
Glaze with tomato paste and vinegar; bake at 375°F 55–60 minutes.

name: Bison Burgers with Portobello Buns
steps: Brush portobellos with oil; grill 4 minutes per side.
Form bison patties; grill 5 minutes per side; top with cheddar.
Assemble burgers between mushroom caps with tomato, onion, arugula, Dijon.

name: Pork Stir-Fry with Snap Peas & Ginger
steps: Toss pork strips with arrowroot and half the tamari; stir-fry in oil; remove.
Stir-fry snap peas, pepper, ginger, garlic 3 minutes.
Return pork with remaining tamari, vinegar, sesame oil; serve over cauliflower rice.

name: Slow Cooker Pot Roast with Root Vegetables
steps: Sear seasoned roast in oil on all sides.
Place in slow cooker with vegetables, garlic, broth, tomato paste, herbs.
Cook on low 8 hours; shred and serve with the vegetables and juices.

name: Lamb Chops with Mint Yogurt & Roasted Cauliflower
steps: Roast cauliflower with half the oil and cumin at 425°F 22 minutes.
Season chops with garlic, lemon zest, salt; sear 3–4 minutes per side.
Mix yogurt, mint, lemon juice; serve alongside.

name: Beef Stuffed Cabbage Rolls (Cauliflower Rice)
steps: Blanch cabbage leaves 3 minutes. Mix beef, cauliflower rice, sautéed onion, egg, garlic, paprika, salt.
Roll filling in leaves; place seam-down in a dish; pour over tomato sauce and tomatoes.
Cover and bake at 350°F 70 minutes; garnish dill.

name: Pork Carnitas Bowls
steps: Slow-cook pork with orange, lime, garlic, cumin, oregano, onion, broth, salt on low 4 hours.
Shred; crisp under the broiler 5 minutes.
Bowl with cauliflower rice, beans, pico, avocado, cilantro.

name: Beef Bulgogi Lettuce Wraps
steps: Marinate thinly sliced beef in tamari, grated pear, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, sweetener 20 minutes.
Sear in a hot pan with avocado oil 2 minutes per batch.
Serve in lettuce with kimchi, green onion, sesame.

name: Italian Sausage & Pepper Zoodles
steps: Brown pork with fennel seeds, seasoning and pepper flakes (homemade sausage).
Add peppers, onion, garlic; cook 6 minutes; add marinara.
Serve over sautéed zoodles with parmesan.

name: Beef Taco Stuffed Zucchini
steps: Halve zucchini; scoop centers and chop.
Brown beef with onion, zucchini flesh, seasoning; add beans and salsa.
Fill boats, top with cheddar; bake at 400°F 20 minutes; serve with yogurt and cilantro.

name: Pork Chops with Roasted Brussels & Balsamic
steps: Roast halved sprouts with half the oil at 425°F 20 minutes.
Season chops with rosemary and garlic; sear 4–5 minutes per side.
Toss sprouts with balsamic and Dijon; serve with chops.

name: Shepherd's Pie with Cauliflower Mash
steps: Brown lamb with onion, carrot, mushrooms, garlic; add tomato paste, broth, thyme, peas; simmer 10 minutes.
Steam cauliflower; mash with butter, milk, parmesan, salt.
Spread mash over filling; bake at 400°F 25 minutes.

name: Beef & Mushroom Stroganoff (Yogurt)
steps: Sear beef strips in oil; remove. Sauté mushrooms, onion, garlic 8 minutes; add paprika, broth, Dijon.
Stir in yogurt off the heat; return beef.
Serve over al dente whole wheat pasta with parsley.

name: Pork Tenderloin Medallions with Mushroom Sauce
steps: Slice pork into medallions; season; sear 3 minutes per side; remove.
Sauté mushrooms, shallot, garlic, thyme; add wine and broth; reduce; stir in yogurt off heat.
Return pork; serve with green beans.

name: Beef Fajita Bowls
steps: Season steak with chili powder, cumin, lime; grill and slice.
Sauté peppers and onion in oil until charred.
Bowl cauliflower rice, beans, steak, peppers, avocado, salsa, yogurt, cilantro.

name: Lamb Kofta with Cucumber Salad
steps: Mix lamb, grated onion, herbs, garlic, spices, salt; shape onto skewers.
Grill 12 minutes, turning.
Serve with cucumber-tomato salad and lemon yogurt.

name: Cuban Ropa Vieja
steps: Sear steak in oil; remove. Sauté peppers, onion, garlic; add cumin, oregano, wine.
Add tomatoes, broth, bay, steak; simmer covered 2.5 hours until shreddable.
Shred, return to sauce with olives; serve over cauliflower rice.

name: Pork & Green Bean Stir-Fry with Garlic
steps: Blister green beans in avocado oil over high heat 5 minutes; remove.
Brown pork with garlic and ginger; add tamari, vinegar, chili crisp.
Return beans; toss with sesame oil and green onion.

name: Beef Kebab Bowls with Tabbouleh
steps: Mix beef with grated onion, a third of the parsley, garlic, cumin, paprika, salt; form kebabs; grill 10 minutes.
Toss bulgur with remaining parsley, tomato, cucumber, mint, lemon, oil.
Serve kebabs over tabbouleh with yogurt.

name: Garlic Butter Steak Bites with Zucchini
steps: Sear beef cubes in oil over high heat 2 minutes per side; remove.
Sauté zucchini 4 minutes; add butter and garlic 1 minute.
Return beef; toss with parsley and pepper flakes.

name: Pork Souvlaki with Greek Salad
steps: Marinate pork cubes in lemon, oil, garlic, oregano, salt 20 minutes; skewer; grill 10–12 minutes.
Toss tomato, cucumber, onion, olives, feta.
Serve with yogurt-dill sauce.

name: Beef Ragu over Spaghetti Squash
steps: Brown beef cubes in oil; sauté onion, carrot, celery, garlic; add wine, tomatoes, broth, rosemary.
Simmer covered 80 minutes; shred beef into sauce.
Roast squash; serve ragu over strands with parmesan.

name: Pork Egg Roll in a Bowl
steps: Brown pork in oil with garlic and ginger.
Add slaw, tamari, vinegar; cook 5 minutes until wilted; push aside, scramble eggs.
Finish with sesame oil, green onion, sriracha.

name: Beef & Bean Enchilada Casserole (Low-Carb)
steps: Brown beef with onion and cumin; stir in beans and chiles.
Layer tortillas, beef, sauce and cheese in a dish.
Bake at 375°F 25 minutes; serve with yogurt and cilantro.

name: Pork Loin with Mustard Herb Crust & Green Beans
steps: Rub pork with Dijon, garlic, herbs, salt; press on almond flour.
Roast at 400°F 20 minutes (tenderloin) to 145°F; rest.
Serve with green beans tossed in oil.

name: Beef Barbacoa Lettuce Tacos
steps: Blend chipotle, garlic, cumin, oregano, lime, vinegar, broth; pour over beef in slow cooker with bay leaves.
Cook on low 5 hours; shred.
Serve in lettuce with onion, cilantro, cotija.

name: Pork Chops with Peach Salsa
steps: Rub chops with paprika and salt; grill 4–5 minutes per side.
Dice peach, onion, jalapeño; toss with cilantro and lime.
Serve chops with salsa over arugula.

name: Beef Zucchini Lasagna
steps: Slice zucchini into planks; salt, drain 15 minutes, blot; grill briefly.
Brown beef with garlic and seasoning; add marinara. Mix ricotta, egg, spinach.
Layer; top with mozzarella and parmesan; bake at 375°F 40 minutes; rest 10.

name: Vietnamese Pork Meatball Bowls
steps: Mix pork, garlic, half the fish sauce, green onion, ginger; form meatballs; pan-fry in oil 10 minutes.
Toss cabbage, carrot, cucumber, herbs with lime, vinegar and remaining fish sauce.
Serve over cauliflower rice with peanuts.

name: Steak Fajita Lettuce Wraps
steps: Season steak; sear 4 minutes per side; rest, slice.
Sauté peppers and onion in oil until charred.
Fill romaine leaves with steak, peppers, guacamole, salsa.

name: Pork Tenderloin Stir-Fry with Bok Choy
steps: Stir-fry pork strips in oil; remove.
Stir-fry shiitake, garlic, ginger; add bok choy 3 minutes.
Return pork with tamari, vinegar, sesame oil; top sesame.

name: Beef Picadillo
steps: Brown beef with onion, pepper, garlic; add spices.
Add tomatoes, paste, olives, capers; simmer 20 minutes.
Serve over cauliflower rice.

name: Rosemary Lamb Leg with Roasted Vegetables
steps: Rub lamb with garlic, rosemary, lemon zest, oil, Dijon, salt; rest 30 minutes.
Roast at 375°F 75–90 minutes to 135°F for medium-rare, adding vegetables around it after 30 minutes.
Rest 15 minutes; slice thin.

name: Cheeseburger Salad
steps: Brown beef; season; drain.
Whisk yogurt, mayo, mustard and pickle juice into 'special sauce'.
Toss romaine, tomato, pickle, onion; top with beef, cheddar, sauce.

name: Pork & Cabbage Dumpling-Filling Skillet
steps: Brown pork with ginger and garlic in oil.
Add cabbage, tamari, vinegar; cook 5 minutes.
Finish with sesame oil, green onion, chili crisp.

name: Beef Stuffed Peppers with Cauliflower Rice
steps: Halve peppers; roast 10 minutes.
Brown beef with onion, garlic, seasoning; add cauliflower rice and tomatoes.
Fill peppers, top with mozzarella; bake at 400°F 20 minutes.

name: Pork Chile Verde
steps: Broil tomatillos, poblano, jalapeño, onion, garlic 10 minutes; blend with cilantro.
Brown pork cubes in oil; add sauce, cumin, broth; simmer covered 1.5–2 hours.
Finish with lime; serve with cauliflower rice.

name: Steak & Eggs Power Bowl with Kale
steps: Roast diced sweet potato with half the oil at 425°F 18 minutes.
Sear steak 4 minutes per side; rest, slice. Sauté kale with garlic; fry eggs.
Bowl everything with avocado and hot sauce.

name: Greek Beef Meatballs with Zucchini Salad
steps: Mix beef, feta, onion, garlic, oregano, mint, egg, almond flour, salt; form meatballs; bake at 400°F 18 minutes.
Shave zucchini; toss with tomato, lemon, oil.
Serve with yogurt.

name: Bacon-Wrapped Pork Tenderloin with Asparagus
steps: Rub pork with Dijon, garlic, thyme; wrap in bacon.
Roast at 425°F 25 minutes to 145°F; broil 2 minutes to crisp.
Roast asparagus with oil alongside; slice pork.

name: Beef Shawarma Plate
steps: Marinate sliced steak in spices, garlic, lemon, oil 15 minutes; sear in a hot pan 5 minutes.
Whisk tahini with lemon and water.
Plate beef with hummus, tomato, cucumber, onion, parsley, tahini sauce.

name: Pork Ribs (Baked, Sugar-Free Rub)
steps: Rub ribs with spices, sweetener, salt; wrap in foil; bake at 300°F 2 hours.
Mix tomato paste, vinegar, Dijon into a glaze; brush on and broil 5 minutes.
Serve with yogurt slaw.
